OUT = Path('/workspace/scratch/ecdev-selected-central-fresh-20261017')
SOURCE = Path('/workspace/ECDEV')
PACKAGE = SOURCE / 'research/commerce/governance/price-source-package-c973d76b-v1.json'
PINS = {
    '--sha256': 'be31c8f8067af13502194f81d2642e0eddd184f1856f3b96b64066227a9716bd',
    '--commit': 'c973d76bda8476142dd64116b60877942ccb24d5',
    '--tree': '1020e7ebdc85befdd0e6ee4d73e4417779228f2c',
    '--rights-sha256': 'c3bfc1ccf9a84d950cd3cf663f6f2062c2470b22515ab877ed6b1563d9cd6410',
}


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


build = json.loads((OUT / 'build.json').read_bytes())
assert build['exit'] == 0
binary = Path(build['rebuilt_binary']['path'])
assert sha(binary.read_bytes()) == build['rebuilt_binary']['sha256']
raw = PACKAGE.read_bytes()
assert sha(raw) == PINS['--sha256']
original = json.loads(raw)
assert canonical(original) == raw
room = OUT / 'fresh-cli-cwd'
room.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
inputs = OUT / 'refusal-inputs'
inputs.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update({'PATH': '/nonexistent-ecdev-qualification-no-external-tools', 'LC_ALL': 'C'})
results = []


def args(package=PACKAGE, pins=None):
    argv = [str(binary), 'migrate', 'inspect-selected', '--file', str(package)]
    for flag, value in (PINS if pins is None else pins).items():
        argv.extend([flag, value])
    return argv + ['--json']


def execute(name, argv, expected_exit, expected_message=None):
    start = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=room, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    for channel, data in [('stdout', p.stdout), ('stderr', p.stderr)]:
        (OUT / (name + '.' + channel)).write_bytes(data)
    record = {
        'name': name,
        'observed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'argv': argv,
        'cwd': str(room),
        'environment': {'PATH': env['PATH'], 'LC_ALL': env['LC_ALL']},
        'exit': p.returncode,
        'expected_exit': expected_exit,
        'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic() - start, 3),
        'stdout_bytes': len(p.stdout),
        'stdout_sha256': sha(p.stdout),
        'stderr_bytes': len(p.stderr),
        'stderr_sha256': sha(p.stderr),
    }
    if expected_exit == 0:
        recorded = base64.b64decode((SOURCE / 'research/commerce/governance/central-selected-package-a095975b/cli-current.log.b64').read_bytes(), validate=False)
        expected = json.loads((SOURCE / 'research/commerce/governance/central-selected-package-contract-a095975b-v1.json').read_bytes())['expected_central_result']
        assert json.loads(p.stdout) == expected, name
        assert p.stdout == recorded, name
        record['summary_bytes_equal_published_recorded_cli'] = True
        record['result'] = json.loads(p.stdout)
    else:
        assert p.stdout.startswith(b'error:'), (name, p.stdout, p.stderr)
        record['refusal'] = p.stdout.decode()
    if expected_message is not None:
        assert expected_message.encode() in p.stdout, (name, p.stdout)
    assert p.returncode == expected_exit and p.stderr == b'', (name, p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr)
    record['status'] = 'PASS'
    results.append(record)
    (OUT / 'fresh-cli-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(name + ': PASS (exit ' + str(p.returncode) + ')', flush=True)


execute('accept-original', args(), 0)
for flag, value in PINS.items():
    label = flag.removeprefix('--')
    wrong = dict(PINS)
    wrong[flag] = '0' * len(value)
    execute('refuse-wrong-' + label, args(pins=wrong), 2)
    omitted = {k: v for k, v in PINS.items() if k != flag}
    execute('refuse-missing-' + label, args(pins=omitted), 2, 'Every independent pin is required exactly once')
    execute('refuse-duplicate-' + label, args() + [flag, value], 2, 'Every independent pin is required exactly once')
missing_file = args()
del missing_file[3:5]
execute('refuse-missing-file-option', missing_file, 2)
execute('refuse-duplicate-file-option', args() + ['--file', str(PACKAGE)], 2)
execute('refuse-extra-positional', args() + ['extra'], 2)
execute('refuse-unknown-option', args() + ['--unknown'], 2)
execute('refuse-out-option', args() + ['--out', str(inputs / 'must-not-be-created')], 2)
upper = dict(PINS)
upper['--sha256'] = upper['--sha256'].upper()
execute('refuse-uppercase-sha256', args(pins=upper), 2, 'four independent lowercase pins required')
execute('refuse-missing-input', args(inputs / 'missing.json'), 2)
execute('refuse-directory-input', args(inputs), 2)
(inputs / 'leaf-link').symlink_to(PACKAGE)
execute('refuse-symlink-leaf', args(inputs / 'leaf-link'), 2)
(inputs / 'ancestor-link').symlink_to(PACKAGE.parent, target_is_directory=True)
execute('refuse-symlink-ancestor', args(inputs / 'ancestor-link' / PACKAGE.name), 2)
os.mkfifo(inputs / 'fifo')
execute('refuse-fifo-input', args(inputs / 'fifo'), 2)
with (inputs / 'oversized.json').open('wb') as f:
    f.truncate((24 << 20) + 1)
execute('refuse-oversized-input', args(inputs / 'oversized.json'), 2)
execute('refuse-parent-component', args(inputs / '..' / 'refusal-inputs' / 'oversized.json'), 2)
tampered = bytearray(raw)
tampered[-2] ^= 1
(inputs / 'tampered-original-pin.json').write_bytes(tampered)
execute('refuse-tampered-original-pin', args(inputs / 'tampered-original-pin.json'), 2, 'independent package digest differs')


def mutated(name, mutate):
    value = copy.deepcopy(original)
    mutate(value)
    data = canonical(value)
    file = inputs / (name + '.json')
    file.write_bytes(data)
    changed_pins = dict(PINS)
    changed_pins['--sha256'] = sha(data)
    execute('refuse-' + name, args(file, changed_pins), 2)
